ns2:section.sectionText: The objective of the course is to present background materials as well as an in-depth discussions of our current state of knowledge about Earth's interior and how the deep Earth is explored. The focus will be on seismological aspects and physical interpretations. In this abbreviated session, we'll focus on low velocity zones and seismic anisotropy and how they related to processes of melting, flow, and evolution. The format will be a combination of lectures and in-depth discussion of classical and current papers. 2 credit hours. Standard Letter Graded
